fusions.name: Up From the Reeds
fusions.desc: A springing bite that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly Splash
fusions.desc: Lands with a slam that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns them for 1 second and restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Bounding Lunge
fusions.desc: Springs you 4 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Still Before the Spring
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
